ActionKey.description:
An action as a caller saw it, to cancel it: in a plan, a revision and
an epoch. A key whose action a later revision replaced, or whose epoch
has ended, is stale: refused, and nothing cancelled. An occurrence of
None, for a recurring action, means every occurrence still to come.
ActionKey.title: ActionKey

ActionOutcome.description:
One planned action's end. Its fields agree with its status: an action
that ran has its times and its executor; one that never started has
neither, and says why; only a cancelled or superseded one names who did
it, only a missed one its fallback, only one that ran its effect, which
is its action's kind's. `resolved_at`, when the outcome was decided, is
always set and orders the log; `due` is None only for an
as-soon-as-possible action dropped before it could start.
ActionOutcome.title: ActionOutcome

ActionRef.description:
Which action a record is about: a planned action, one occurrence of a
recurring one, or the fallback carried out in its place. `str()` spells
it for people, `harvest@3` or `vent/fallback`; records keep the parts.
ActionRef.title: ActionRef

Asap.description:
As soon as what it waits for is done, before its deadline if it has
one.
Asap.title: Asap

CancelPlan.description: The plan in force cancelled, what of it has not started.
CancelPlan.title: CancelPlan

Condition.description:
What a run is made of besides its scenario: its seed, its weather by
name, and how many whole days it lasts, each its scenario's own when
none.
Condition.title: Condition

DecisionTraced.description:
One decision of an episode: see the module. A decision kept, or
skipped, gave nothing and has no receipt; so has a cancellation of a
plan never given.
DecisionTraced.title: DecisionTraced

Delivered.description:
What one log delivered at a decision: how many records, and the
SHA-256 of their JSON, one line each, in delivery order (`delivered`).
Delivered.title: Delivered

DeliveredLogs.description: What each of a policy's logs delivered at a decision.
DeliveredLogs.title: DeliveredLogs

EpisodePlace.description:
Where an episode stands in its experiment: the experiment, and the
condition and policy it pairs, by their places in it from 0.
EpisodePlace.title: EpisodePlace

EpisodePolicy.description: The policy an episode ran: see the module.
EpisodePolicy.title: EpisodePolicy

EpisodeRun.description: The run an episode steered: see the module.
EpisodeRun.title: EpisodeRun

ExecutorRef.description:
Who carries an action out: a kind of executor, and which one, or any
of the kind when `id` is None.
ExecutorRef.title: ExecutorRef

ForecastUncertainty.description: How a provider's forecasts state their uncertainty.
ForecastUncertainty.title: ForecastUncertainty

InformationBasis.description: What a forecast or an asset is made from.
InformationBasis.title: InformationBasis

InformationBudget.description: An episode's budget: see the module.
InformationBudget.title: InformationBudget

Keep.description: The plan in force, kept as it is.
Keep.title: Keep

Lower.description:
Lower a plant's stem: by so many centimetres, by so many internodes,
or until its top has so much head room under its wire. Exactly one.
Lower.title: Lower

ModelRan.description:
A part of the run, the model it ran and that model's version, and the
parameter set it ran with: none for a model that names none, as in every
record written before sets were named.
ModelRan.title: ModelRan

ObservationType.description:
What an Observation measures. The value doubles as the unit-bearing
field name on the reconstructed state models (EnvironmentState,
GreenhouseEnvironmentState), so a new greenhouse-level type is one enum
member plus one optional field, no mapping table.

Plant-level readings come from a sensor or vision pass on one plant;
greenhouse-level readings (plant_id None) describe the compartment's
climate, its control state, or a manual sample across plants. Recorded
setpoints are observations of what the controller was asked to do, not
events: they are continuous 5-minute state, not discrete interventions.
ObservationType.title: ObservationType

OnLate.description:
What a gateway does with an action that cannot start by its due
instant and tolerance.
OnLate.title: OnLate

ParameterSetRan.description:
The parameter set a model ran with: its name, version and digest, and
the version of the model it was made for, which may be another than the
one run.
ParameterSetRan.title: ParameterSetRan

PolicyEntry.description:
A policy as an experiment makes it: its factory, by its import path
(`module:callable`), given its settings, a JSON object, and its seed,
none for a policy that does not draw. `files` names the settings that
are paths to files the policy reads, such as a network's weights.
PolicyEntry.title: PolicyEntry

PolicyFile.description: A file a policy read, by the setting naming it, and its SHA-256.
PolicyFile.title: PolicyFile

PolicyIdentity.description: A policy, as an experiment names it: its name and its version.
PolicyIdentity.title: PolicyIdentity

PolicyMade.description: A policy's entry, and the digests of its settings and its files.
PolicyMade.title: PolicyMade

PredictionAsset.description:
A prediction model or a calibration a policy is given: named,
versioned, and pinned by its bytes' digest.
PredictionAsset.title: PredictionAsset

Principal.description:
Who asks for an action, by identity: a person, a control policy, a
schedule, a scenario's own plan, a platform.
Principal.title: Principal

Receipt.description:
A gateway's answer to a write. A request refused whole has its
errors and changed nothing; one accepted lists what it refused at once,
what it cancelled, and the keys it would not act on.
Receipt.title: Receipt

Recurrence.description:
Every `period`, `count` times or until an instant: occurrence `n`,
from 0, is the planned action's timing moved by `n` periods. The timing
is its one anchor.
Recurrence.title: Recurrence

Revise.description:
The actions of the policy's plan's next revision, which the runner
makes and gives: from then on they replace those of the revision in
force not yet started, as the gateway's rule has it.
Revise.title: Revise

SetLevel.description:
A device's level, from 0 (off) to 1 (full), or `auto` to hand the
device back to whatever control loop runs it. A door or vent is a
device, its level how far it is open.
SetLevel.title: SetLevel

SetTarget.description:
A climate controller's heating setpoint, by day or by night, in °C.
Each kind of target has its own unit and range: the venting and humidity
targets, when a controller has them, are members of their own beside
this one.
SetTarget.title: SetTarget

WeatherSeries.description:
The weather a run was under, from its start to its end, every
`every_s`: the SHA-256 of each moment's state as its producer writes it,
one line each.
WeatherSeries.title: WeatherSeries

Window.description:
Due between two instants: it starts at the earliest one in them an
executor can honour and is free to take.
Window.title: Window

description: An episode, as its record names it: see the module.
title: EpisodeRecord
